# A transaction and a split each stating a custom key as the empty text.
#
# `key: ""` is the empty text, which a custom key holds like any other text;
# only `$None$` removes a key. The rule README states under "What a key says,
# and what leaving it out says".
#
# What this fixture produces: one transaction carrying `region: "west"` and
# `department: ""`, whose bank split carries `project: ""`, each written back
# by the export as stated.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_key_stated_empty_holds_the_empty_text.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Sundry
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-01 * "Kept some keys, emptied others"
	region: "west"
	department: ""
	Assets:Bank -20.00 CAD
		project: ""
	Expenses:Sundry 20.00 CAD
